Title: Official report for ACC(Asian Continental Championship) 2011 Manila

Messages.Author: blackday
Messages.Body:
The Asian Continental Championships pushed through on Oct 9, 2011 at Schizo Art Cafe in Katipunan Ave., Quezon City Philippines. This cozy and secluded area was the chosen location for this year's ACC, the event started close to 10am after almost an hour of registration and organizing the prizes. We had a total of 25 players (17 from the Philippines, 3 Japanese and 5 Singaporeans) and we had a multijudge event and had 3 rounds+ Final (for an even 5 tables of 5). The host of Scizo served the players breakfast/lunch and dinner for the said event, so we made good time on the tourney time. This is because we eliminated the need to wait for players to come back to start the table. Each round was 2 hours long which was sufficient except for one notable exception which involved the Salubri. Free giveaways for the participants included a VTES ACC shirt and booster packs (1 Httb and 1 3rd ed) and a starter randomly drawn.

(This is mostly extrapolated from Stephen's accounts phrased in the 3rd person perspective)
The game started with Gee Hwuan hyper bleeding Eric for 6 with Didi Meyers, and then another 4. Coupled that with the 7 pool that Eric spent on Teresita, effectively placed Eric on a precarious position trying to defend against a very aggressive and relentless predator.

Stephen sent Howler to Deep Song Didi and eventually sent her into torpor, knowing very well that it would only slow down Gee Hwuan by a bit, hopefully stalling the hyperbleed deck. Troy follows suit and also plays Deep Song by Ivan Krenyenko, Gee Hwuan's other vampire(Roland Bishop) and sending that vampire into torpor as well. This gave Eric some breathing room as Gee Hwuan was forced down to four pool to influence his next vampire Ozmo, to have any chance of gaining a VP before he loses his advantage.
Karl not hesitating to take advantage of such a great opportunity, proceeded to play Vaticinated by Lydia. Stephen blocks it with the help of a Draba from Troy, but Karl played another one with his other Trujah(Al Muntathir), and removed Deflection from Gee Hwuan's hand, and proceeded to oust Gee Hwuan with a bleed. Karl then ousted the severely weakened Eric, gaining 12 pool and 2 VPs all in a single round!

At this point things were looking quite bad for both Troy and Stephen. Stephen proceeded to use entrancement on Troy's Carlton Van Wyk, and succeeded in gaining control of the pesky ally. This bolstered Stephen's minions as he had Howler, Bobby Lemon and Nettie on table but was down to 11 pool, fearing for the Domain of evernight/Outside the Hourglass combo of Karl which would require him to throw out young vampires as a distraction for Lydia for him to survive, Stephen took the risk of bringing out Juanita bringing his pool down to 7. Things were worst for Troy, with so much pool committed to his 2 old vampires and a lot of equipment(Shimulo Tarot, heart of nizchetus, seal of veddartha, etc.), he was down to 4 or 5 pool with some help of of Stephen's howling Ahrimanes.

Striking a deal with his prey, Stephen focused on entering combat with and blocking the Trujah, with average success. Meanwhile, Karl DI-ed a Sense Dep from Troy and Lydia was already fully set up with Ankara, and had summoned the Veneficti. Stephen was lucky enough to have Carlton but the +1 intercept proved futile. Eventually, Karl got Stephen to block Lydia with Carlton, and was promptly killed him off with Outside the Hourglass.

Luck came to Stephen's rescue at this point again. His Ashur Tablets trio were activated and he drew back into his hand the Entrancement, taking the Veneficti away from Karl, which probably saved him a lot of pool. Multiple Engling Fury replenished his Ahrimane's blood, and a timely Vulture Buffet topped it up to make his position a lot stronger.

By then Karl had several vampires too(Lydia, Al Muntathir, and Andre Le Roux), and a bucket load of pool. Mind Numbs were used to reduce his available blockers (usually Bobby, he got mind numbed twice in the game), and a Codex of Edenic Groundskeeper made Stephen play very carefully and always keep at least 2 if not more vampires untapped to deal with Karl's bleeds.

Troy however had managed to successfully place a Sense Dep on Lydia while she was tapped, giving both Troy and Stephen a breather. Stephen slowly bled Troy for 1 or 2, making sure he didn't recover from the damage that Stephen's small bleeds had done, but with enough juice to go forward. With Troy at 4 pool most of the time, Stephen made a calculated risk that keeping Troy weak but in play was a better option as he needed Troy's Sensory Deprivation and so put the game speed into a crawl. Karl played a more defensive game as he tried to recover from Lydia's predicament, and Troy was wary of tapping his minions for bleeds, which gave Stephen the advantage of gaining pool from the edge as much as he could (about several turns worth).

Due to the Sense Dep, Karl's effort turned towards Troy, and the two of them had several combats as Al munthatir tried to engage Ivan Krenyenko. During the confusion, Stephen had another 3 Ashur Tablets activated, and now had a good healthy pool and 5 active minions to fall back on. When Karl finally diablerized Troy's Sense-Depping vampire with Lydia, Stephen saw no real need to keep Troy alive and ousted him to get close to Karl.

There were several combats which went to and fro for a while, in the end the Venficti was destroyed with an Outside the Hourglass (again); some of Stephen's bleeds went through; and couple of Karl's vampires were torpored(Andre and Al Muntathir); Bobby was Mind Numbed again but Stephen was however pretty successful in keeping the Edge.

Nothing very interesting happened for several turns until Stephen sent Howler into combat with Lydia. By then she wasn't in very good shape, and Howler is a great vampire in combat. With Crows and Bats and some presses Stephen sent Lydia to torpor; needless to say he quickly diablerized her with Juniata, gaining quite a few equipment along the way - including a Heart from Troy. (Equipment and allies were very mobile in this game). Prior to diablerizing Lydia, Stephen was pondering whether or not I should just leave her there and disallowed Karl to bring out another Lydia (Karl had only a single vampire Al Muntathir left with 4 blood) - that would be a complete crippling blow to Karl since he had no easy way to use all his TEM powers any more. But looking at his stack of pool, Stephen felt that maybe it was easier to force Karl to transfer those pool for another Lydia. Afterall, a new Lydia would still need time and blood to do all her setup again, giving Stephen plenty of opportunity to send her to torpor all over if necessary. And of course, there was the Heart to think about.

Karl didn't manage to recover in time to deal with Stephen's bleeds. When the new Trujah(Lydia) finally hit the table, a Legal Manipulation with Aire of Elation bypassed his Quicksilver Contemplation to give Stephen the win.

Karl - 2 VPs
Stephen - 3 VPs + GW
